messages:
pd-bot: PagerDuty HIGH alert: runtime-proxy-prod — alert_id PD12345 — symptom: upstream_5xx_rate > 5% for 30s. Paging oncall team. https://pagerduty.example/PD12345

Jamal: acked — I'm looking. starting with logs and metrics, assigning to self.

incident-bot: incident-bot: page delivered to @Jamal @Mike @Tara — escalations: none yet.

Mike: seeing a short 5xx burst in us-west-2 on the runtime-proxy nodes. Spike lasts ~40s in the NLB metrics. Not seeing correlated Sentry errors from customers yet.

Tara: checking autoscaler + recent infra events. Any deploys in the last 5m?

DeployBot: deploy-bot: deploy finished — runtime-proxy-prod v2.3.7 by Dmitri at 10:14:22 UTC. Canary passed.

Jamal: ok that timestamp lines up. running quick health curl loop to reproduce locally:
```
for i in {1..10}; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" https://runtime-proxy.prod/health; sleep 1; done
```

Jamal: results: 200 200 502 200 200 200 502 200 200 200 — two transient 502s, matches PD window.

Mike: logs show a few TCP resets from the NLB to backend instance during the deploy window. Could be connection draining timing out.

Tara: I rolled the proxy keepalive back to previous setting on one node (quick rollback of socket tuning) and bumped connection drain timeout to 60s. Watching metrics.

Jamal: metric graph: error rate back to baseline and latency normalized. No user-facing 5xx spikes in the last 5m.

incident-bot: incident-bot: alert PD12345 auto-resolved at +65s. No further triggers in the last 2 evaluation windows.

Jamal: confirming auto-resolve. From what I see this is a transient NLB/backend connection handshake during the rolling deploy — likely not code regressions. No customer-impact found in Sentry or support tickets within the window. Marking as no-impact for customers. :white_check_mark: 

Mike: filing follow-up ticket to infra: "NLB connection drain timing vs runtime-proxy rolling deploy" and assigning to Dmitri. I'll include timing graphs and the curl output.

Dmitri: got it — I'll take a look this afternoon. If it's just timing/drain config we can tweak the deploy playbook to reduce noise. If it recurs we'll run a short postmortem.

Tara: handing off to next oncall, please note in the shift log @oncall-scheduler. Main takeaways: transient 5xx during deploy, auto-resolved, no customer impact, follow-up ticket created.

oncall-scheduler: (bot note) shift log updated for 2026-03-15 10:xx UTC — incident PD12345 documented.

Jamal: closing thread for now. ping me if PD12345 reopens or if infra finds further anomalies.

Mike: thanks all. :thumbsup:
